reviews.text: THE. BEST. HAIRCUT for our Maltipoo, ever! These people aren't pet groomers, they are ARTISTS! Needless to say, we are back today for the 2nd haircut for Bella. My vote for best haircut/wash for dogs in the city, the state, the country! Thank you so much!
We’ve been coming here for probably 10 years now for a cut and grind. Andy’s always so kind. My dog can be very nervous getting her nails trimmed but they’re always so good with her

Honestly, this place needs to learn how to do better. It took me 8 times to call on Saturday to get one appointment. I understand being busy, but sending your clients call to voicemail then picking up and putting me on hold for 10 minutes and forgetting about it is so frustrating and terrible customer service. To add onto it after being on hold, I hung up and called back and someone finally answered. And as I’m talking to them trying to explain my frustrations, the woman on the phone continued to talk over me and wouldn’t listen. She claimed they were busy and have 3 people answering phones… if that was the case someone would’ve picked up in one of my first 7 calls. She also claimed they always call back.. not once did I get a call back from 10:52am (my first call) to 1:20pm (my 7th call) before someone actually picked up on the 8th. They gave me an appointment for Sunday morning which is what I needed, and I decided to go through with it as a second chance. I dropped him off and picked him up, with a missing patch of hair in his back side. Now, my dog has had these spots before but they’ve always been small and have always came and gone due to his allergies. I feel like if they were going to cut or shave a big patch like this, I should’ve gotten a call giving me a heads up or asking if it was okay. I don’t think I’m ever taking my dog back. All I can think about is if they hurt my dog in any way shape or form. I can only imagine what they would do to other dogs or how some others come out leaving this place.

Update 6/29/26 - they responded and said they tried calling me but their call went to voicemail. Their number is saved in my contacts and I had my phone with me the whole time while I was waiting for him to be finished grooming. Not once did they call me, I can provide screenshots of my call log if needed. The only time I got a call from them was when they told me to pick up my dog because he was ready.

Additionally, MY DOG IS A FRENCH BULLDOG. HE’S SHORT HAIRED. Please make it make sense as to how a short haired dog ended up with “tangles” and had to be removed with a dematting brush. TAKE ACCOUNTABILITY FOR YOUR MISTAKE. And if you’re going to try and lie, at least do it a little better and make sure you have your facts in check.

The absolute best groomer in LA! Simon is such a sweetheart and every dog walks out happy. I take my good friend’s Frenchie and he loves being groomed. We’ve done the works several times. It’s always a great experience.
Every single year they take care Tuna breath's haircut, and she comes out w new found confidence every time 💪🏽

I am previous customer of this business & find the owner Simon to be very rude, as we have contacted them about this concern many times!

As another customer has already stated, they simply lock up pets in a back cage and forget about them! We also live close by and can hear dogs crying out for literally hours, with no attendance (see video).

Andy's Daycare, at least check on the animals in you care on a regular basis, they are barking non stop for a reason!!!!!!!!!!!
I found a stray dog yesterday and they immediately took him in and gave me a great discount on the grooming and free flea treatment! They are the BEST! I have been going for years :)

Went to Andy’s initially because it was family owned and here we are (9 years later!!), still taking the owner’s advice on my Charlie’s health and wellness. From grooming to dental care to kibble and treats- the owners and workers truly know their products and love dogs.
This place is a GEM!

This is the first time taking my pets Lily, Simba, Jackson and Dax to this vet. All of the staff took very good care of them. I would recommend them to every pet person I know. Thank you so much for the great service.

I bring my cat sage here regularly and we get the lions cut and he always looks so cute. We have had memberships for sage annually to make sure we keep his fur styled year around, and would highly recommend Andy's to anyone looking for a good cat groomer.
We love this place because of the care, service and price. The time it takes is over the top compared to other groomers that can take 3 to 4 hours.

Andy’s Grooming is a great place for your dog.  I’ve been going here for many years. The staff are gentle and caring, and they make sure each dog looks clean and happy. The place is great, and my dogs always come out looking their best.

I’ve been bringing Lenny to Andy’s Pet Grooming for almost 4 years now, and it’s truly our go-to grooming place!
The staff is always kind, gentle, and professional , they treat Lenny like family every single time. He always comes home looking (and smelling!) amazing, perfectly trimmed, and happy.

This time, he even got a winter-themed bandanna, which made him look extra adorable! 🧡
Highly recommend Andy’s for anyone who wants their pup to be pampered and cared for with love.

I saw a few negative reviews saying someone was rude, but honestly, my experience was amazing! I brought both my dog and my cat, and they did such a great job with the grooming. Everyone was super nice and polite. I’ll definitely keep coming back here.
READ THE OTHER REVIEWS. Terrible place. Do not take your dog here. Rough and rushed service. Grooming left my dogs skin cut. All I can say is - READ THE REVIEWS.

READ THE OTHER REVIEWS. This place is trash. From the people who run it to the way they treat their daycare’s dogs. Kept in their own filth. This place needs to be investigated. Onto my own personal experience. They ripped my poor little dogs nail right off the skin. Like caused a huge crack and her nail is now disconnected from the skin around it. I’ve literally never heard of this happening before, they must’ve seriously been so rough and just ripped my dogs nail up so hard and high until it pulled from the skin. If you don’t want your dogs nails to be ripped from the skin-don't come here. If this sounds like something you’d accept for your poor defenseless dog, this is the place! 5 star service if there goal is making dogs bleed and ripping their nails from their skin.
I have been in Los Angeles for 9 1/2 years and I have never been happy with my dog grooming before today. He has very unique hair for a Yorkie and I couldn't be happier with how grooming turned out!

I love Andy's Pet Grooming! Ive been bringing all 3 of my dogs here for the past 5+ years for all types of needs, ranging from grooming to boarding to daycare and even to Andy's Elite K9 training. The team is absolutely lovely and very professional. You can tell they truly go out of their way to take of all yours and your pets needs. I will always be returning!

Love this place. Took my dog for grooming and got good deal on package service for my next 5 visits, manager Simon always takes care of his permanent customers. Thank you again for good service and safety !

I’ve had sleepless nights over how badly I was treated by the owner of this business, Simon. He pushed me to purchase a grooming package ($800+) for my young Bernese Mountain dog. Immediately after purchasing the package, my dog was diagnosed with aggressive T cell lymphoma and died suddenly. Simon refused to refund the grooming package, essentially stealing my money as he provided no services. He lacks empathy, compassion and integrity as a business owner. He is now claiming he wants documentation that my dog is dead. I’m happy to show him the 26k hospital bills and receipt for euthanasia etc. It’s not about the money at this point, it’s the fact that this morally bankrupt individual has no business being trusted with your beloved pets. He will be receiving a nice call from my attorney ASAP.

The owner of this place treated me in the most despicable way you can imagine. If you love your pets, take them elsewhere. Do not give him your business, he is not an animal lover and lacks honesty and integrity in business. He pushed me very hard to purchase a grooming package ($800+) for my 6 year old Bernese Mountain dog.  Within a month of purchasing the package, my sweet boy was diagnosed with lymphoma and passed suddenly. I came into the store with tears in my eyes to ask for my money back and his answer was basically “sucks for you, not my problem”. Luckily, I have avenues to recoup my money but this man lacks a moral compass and should not be anywhere near your furry family members. It’s all about the money for him. No heart, no compassion and no integrity.

First time my dog got kennel, cough here. Second time I picked him up he was completely saturated in urine. They didn’t even clean him. I could tell that they weren’t letting him out. I tried him one more time. I just picked up my dog with two infected eyes. I will never bring my dog here again. Not only are they expensive but they really do not care about your animals at all every time my dog goes there it pees it’s afraid I made the mistake by going back and giving them a chance. I highly recommend you read all the write ups before you take your dog here.   I have tried so hard to give this place a chance… I had to leave my dog there because I was in the hospital. I’ll never do it again.

I had such a great experience here! The grooming space was spotless and very well-kept, which immediately made me feel comfortable bringing my dog in. The staff were professional, friendly, and clearly care about both the pets and their owners. My dogs came out looking and smelling amazing, and I really appreciated the attention to detail. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, professional, and caring grooming service!
Always love bringing my dogs to this groomer. They care about the animals like they are their own and always have a pleaaant experience.
Amazing! Quick and beautiful work !
very rude and unprofessional. I took my dog in and got a really bad feeling with how they were talking to me, so I left... So happy I did. Since then, I know a dog that has died there. So sad.

Being located near this shop is a nightmare.  Once they leave your pet outside in their cage, it will not settle down & continuously bark as they are ignored & not properly attended to, so beware.  If you are the owner of this location, I will remove this post once you start doing your job properly!!!!!

The first time I came here I bought a 10 session grooming package because it would be cheaper than buying individual grooming sessions. Mistake on my part. I have used 8 sessions and when I called to schedule my last two appointments, they told me I had used all of my sessions. However, they couldn’t tell me when I had used these sessions. Their reasoning is that when a customer has an active package, they have a paper file and write down in the file when you use a session, but when your package is done, they only input the first and last session dates into their computer, and then throw away the file. I asked if they had an appointment calendar in their computer that they could check and they said no. The owner said that they have too many customers to keep track of all of this. Which I don’t understand, because this is a business and paperwork is part of a business.

I spoke to the owner trying to figure this out, and he was adamant that they don’t make mistakes and I for sure used them all, and if I had bought a second package, they would have kept my file. I asked if they let customers know when their package is over and ask if they want to re-purchase and he said ‘yes of course’. And I said that no one ever asked me about re-purchasing or told me that my package was ending, and the last time I was in there they told me I had two sessions left. (I also have all of my appointment dates written down in my own calendar and I only show 8). He said he could try and figure out who helped me (although I know he didn’t mean it, and he wasn’t saying it in a way that it would solve anything anyway). I said it was another guy, and the owner said it may have been someone helping out from their other store. I’m not sure why he thinks that’s an explanation- an employee at their other store would still know their procedures.

Very disappointing overall, not only because I lost approximately $180, but also because the owner had no care to apologize or try to work out a solution of any kind. All he kept asking was if I wanted to buy another package and saying I could track it better next time.

I will also say, if I hadn’t of bought a package, I wouldn’t have come back after my first time there. The store smells awful, which is not a great first impression and my dogs were nervous going there, and the employees didn’t try and soothe them at all either. They also kept trying to add on various charges that I was never told about upfront when I bought the package. One time my dog had a couple (couple!) small mattes and they told me they charge extra for it. I was saying I was never told about that. Whoever was helping me that time was nice and told me they wouldn’t charge me extra this time, but to know it for the future.

When I was talking to the owner and another employee about my package issue, they both told me that packages expire after one year. Again, nobody told me that when I bought it, and I’ve also been using it for longer than one year, so them saying that doesn’t make sense. So just be warned about extra charges and polices that may come up if you come here.

My mom called to this place for my dog and a lady answered and when my mom started asking questions she was responding rude to my mom this is unacceptable and no one should ever be rude and disrespectful to their clients . Luckily I found somewhere else where they are very respectful to their clients and are willing to help them with there questions.

Absolutely loved this place! I was very worried how things will end up,  but once I came back to pick up my pups, I was extremely happy with results. My dogs looked beautiful, very well groomed, happy, and relaxed. The staff was welcoming, Rosa, our groomer, was very patient with me and my pointers. She took time to understand my needs and well as my dogs' needs.
The facility is well-organized, has calm, and pet-friendly vibe. They have multiple services that can suite anyone's need. Their services include grooming, training, and daycare.
I can definitely say that I found the best grooming place for my babies.

I can't say enough good things about Andy's Pet Grooming! I brought in my two AKC Pomeranians, and they came out looking absolutely perfect. The groomers were incredibly attentive, making sure every little knot and tangle was taken care of. From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and clearly experienced with multi-coated breeds. The grooming was flawless, the paws were neatly trimmed, and the overall cleanliness was top-notch (they even included the cutest bows!). If you're looking for a groomer that truly understands quality pet grooming, this is the place! I'll definitely be coming back.
Great place. Easy to make an appointment. I’m very happy with the service here. Highly reccomended.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Andy’s Pet Grooming and Daycare is amazing! They took such great care of Chess and Apollo, and they came out looking and feeling fantastic. The staff was super friendly and clearly love what they do. My dogs were happy, relaxed, and perfectly groomed—what more could I ask for? We’ll definitely be back!

Simon (the owner) and his top shelf team are LEGENDARY.
We have a male Pomsky , Bowie, and prior to finding Simon we worked with 2 trainers - to no avail.
We met Simon @Andy's pet in a hopeless state of mind. None of the previous training yielded and no long term results.
Not only did he train our pomsky , Bowie, we were met with a Completely different dog. After 4 weeks with Simon and his team Bowie transformed into our DREAM dog.
Simon and his team sent us videos throughout his training and were ALWAYS responsive and available to and and ALL of our concerns, questions.
The post training was equally dedicated and they have always been available and responsive (within minutes) to any and all questions.
This dedicated team TRULY care about dogs and cats we plan on maintaining a relationship with them - grooming, doggy care - ALL OF IT!
Could not be happier!
Maya Popkin
Los Angeles

Thank you for taking care of Nala!

I recently enrolled my French Bulldog puppy in the board and train program at Andy’s, and I couldn't be happier with the results! The trainers are incredibly knowledgeable and  implemented a structured training plan tailored to my puppy's needs.

The facility was clean and well-maintained, providing a safe environment for my pup to learn and socialize with other dogs. Daily training sessions focused on basic commands, socialization, and positive reinforcement techniques, which made a significant difference in my puppy's behavior at home which was my main goal and concern.

Communication with the trainers was excellent,  they provided regular updates (even sent me videos) and valuable tips for continuing training after the program. I am so grateful to Simon and the team for taking such great care of my puppy and highly recommend the board and train  at Andy’s daycare and Elite K-9 for any Frenchie owner especially looking to give their dog a solid foundation in training while ensuring a fun and enriching experience!
I took my beautiful dog for a grooming for his birthday and that’s the worst decision I ever made. They did horrible job. They transferred my beautiful dog to ugly. I can’t look at him. So unhappy

I’ve been bringing my pitty to Andy’s Pet Grooming for the past 2 years, and I’m always very satisfied with the service. The team is incredibly nice and kind, making my dog feel comfortable every time. They do a fantastic job with grooming, and I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else!

I have been going here for over two years and they have taken such good care of my dog. The entire duration of being their client I do not have a single complaint. I do not say this lightly—great work and phenomenal customer service. 10/10 highly recommend.
Been going here for a while now & have always had a great experience! My dog always comes home so clean and well groomed! Thank you!!
Have been going here for years! Everyone is so warm and friendly and grooming is fast. Milo always comes out looking adorable. Get the package and save yourself some money!

They followed directions well and the cut was nice. But he had so much loose hair on him -  it got all over the car and our shirts - I had to give him a bath as soon as we got home so it didn’t end up all over the house.

Finally after trying so many grooming places in the area, I found the best grooming I was looking for. I took my toy poodle Cookie to Andy’s grooming and they did an amazing service. I highly recommend this place for their professional service and expertise. She came out to be the cutest.
love these guys! they always get my kitty right within 15 min
